mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.subtitle: Enter the code we sent to your email.
mfa.passwordHint: Enter your current password to enable
mfa.requiredByAdmin: Required by administrator — cannot be disabled
mfa.disabledByAdmin: Two-step verification is disabled organization-wide. Contact an administrator if you need to enable it.
mfa.disablePasswordHint: To turn it off, confirm your password. We will email you a code.
mfa.disableCodeSent: We sent a verification code to your email. Enter it to confirm deactivation.
mfa.enrollCodeSent: We sent a verification code to your email. Enter it to confirm activation.
mfa.subtitleTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.subtitleBackup: Enter one of your backup codes. Each one works only once.
mfa.backupLow: You are running low on backup codes. Generate new ones.
mfa.totpIntro: Generate the code on your phone (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator…) and stop depending on email.
mfa.totpProofHint: To switch method, enter the code we emailed you.
mfa.totpScan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app. If you can't scan it, type this key by hand:
mfa.totpQrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.totpEnterCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm.
mfa.totpInvalid: The code is not valid. Check your phone's clock and try again.
mfa.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, each code lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
mfa.backupRegenerateHint: Your current codes will stop working. Confirm your password and an app code (or a backup code).
mfa.disableTotpHint: Enter the code from your authenticator app (or a backup code) to confirm.

forceChange.sameAsCurrent: The new password must be different from the current one
forceChange.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
forceChange.genericError: The password could not be changed. Please try again.
